name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio)
free_tier: Free of charge on the Free Tier: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, 3.8 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, 3.1 Flash-Lite, 3 Flash Preview, 2.5 Flash-Lite, embeddings, Flash TTS models and Gemma 4; 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash are deprecated and API access to the 2.5 models is limited to existing users
rate_limits: Sampled Gemini 2.5 model limits are shown only in AI Studio; quotas vary by model and project. Public docs separately publish selected model quotas: Gemini Decision 1 on the Decisions API, Free tier 200 RPM, 50,000 TPM, 10,000 RPD (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits, read 2026-11-25)
notes: Free-tier prompts/outputs may be used by Google to improve its products outside the UK/CH/EEA/EU. Since the 2026-03-23 terms, only Paid Services may serve API clients to end users in the EEA/CH/UK. Gemini 2.5 Pro and 2.5 Flash are deprecated; the pricing page announces automatic routing to Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.5 Flash-Lite respectively, billed at their rates, from 2026-12-01. The models page says API access to the 2.5 models is limited to users who actively used them before (no start date given); Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite is not deprecated. Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS has no free tier (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models and https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing, read 2026-11-25)
best_for: The only frontier-class model with a genuine free tier

name: Groq
free_tier: Open-weight models (GPT-OSS, Qwen) plus Whisper, no credit card required
rate_limits: Free plan examples: openai/gpt-oss-120b, openai/gpt-oss-20b and qwen/qwen3.8-27b: 30 RPM/1K RPD/8K TPM/200K TPD; Whisper models: 20 RPM/2K RPD/7.2K audio seconds/hour and 28.8K/day; limits vary by model
notes: Limits apply at the organization level, not per API key. qwen/qwen3.8-27b is listed among Preview models, which the models page says are intended for evaluation purposes only
best_for: Lowest-latency inference for open-weight models

name: OpenRouter
free_tier: A rotating set of models with a :free suffix, single API across many providers; availability fluctuates
rate_limits: 20 requests/min; published table: 50 requests/day below 10 credits purchased lifetime, 1,000/day at 10+; docs say the higher daily ceiling starts one credit below the threshold to absorb fees and rounding
notes: Terms prohibit reselling API access or developing a competing service; per-model terms still apply. Upstream providers may train on inputs/outputs. Separate settings for free and paid models can exclude providers that train; router-level opt-in logging and safety/legal retention exceptions still apply (terms, §7 item 4, last updated 2026-08-31, and provider-logging and data-collection docs re-read 2026-11-24; privacy policy read 2026-11-14).
best_for: Widest model selection behind one no-card key

name: Cloudflare Workers AI
free_tier: 10,000 Neurons/day, all account plans
rate_limits: 10,000 Neurons/day (free allocation). Default text generation: 300 requests/min; models requiring paid billing: 20/min with standard billing or 50/min with prepaid AI Gateway credits. Text embeddings: 3,000/min (bge-large-en-v1.5: 1,500/min); speech recognition, text-to-image, translation and image-to-text: 720/min, with model exceptions
notes: Resets daily at 00:00 UTC; overage on a Workers Paid plan bills at $0.011/1,000 Neurons. Some models require a paid billing method: Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits; these are outside no-card free access (nine such models on the pricing page updated 2026-11-18)
best_for: Highest free daily volume for a real side project

name: Cohere
free_tier: Trial (evaluation) API keys covering chat, embed and rerank
rate_limits: 1,000 API calls/month total; 20 req/min chat; 2,000 inputs/min embed; 10 req/min rerank
notes: Free evaluation key; the pricing page says trial keys "are not permitted to be used for production or commercial purposes", and production use requires upgrading to a production key. Cohere privacy policy says trial inputs and outputs may be used for research and product improvement; no trial-specific retention duration is confirmed
best_for: Free embeddings and rerank for RAG prototypes

name: Cerebras
free_tier: $5 in free credits for new accounts, usable across all public models
rate_limits: Free Trial, gpt-oss-120b: 5 RPM / 30,000 uncached TPM / 90,000 total TPM / 1,000,000 TPH / 1,000,000 TPD. Qwen 3.8 27B: 300 RPM / 150,000 uncached TPM, no hourly or daily token caps; the temporary total-TPM increase is excluded
notes: A verified payment method is required to activate Playground/API access; no charge until you separately purchase credits. The one-time $5 trial credit expires 30 days after grant. API and Playground access stop when it expires or is exhausted; there is no permanently free tier
best_for: Wafer-scale inference hardware, with a per-model speed on its models page

name: HuggingFace
free_tier: Free CPU Basic + ZeroGPU for Spaces; Inference Providers has no included credit on the Free plan (credits must be purchased) — $2.00/mo is included only on PRO, and $2.00 per seat on Team/Enterprise
rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published, only credit amounts
notes: Credits only apply with "Routed by Hugging Face" billing, not with a Custom Provider Key
best_for: Router access to many open-weight providers under one key

name: SiliconFlow
free_tier: China platform (siliconflow.cn): models marked free on the public pricing page, including Hunyuan-MT-7B, Xing4.0-29B and BAAI embedding models; no signup-credit allowance is used for this sample
rate_limits: Fixed per-model limits for free models; generic docs cite ranges of 1,000-10,000 RPM and 50,000-5,000,000 TPM depending on model tier — exact limits shown in-account
notes: China platform requires real-name authentication for all free models and phone registration; the accepted documents are listed in the authentication FAQ. Free-model IDs come only from models explicitly marked free at https://www.siliconflow.cn/pricing (read 2026-11-25). Per-model free quotas are fixed but not mapped to exact numbers in the public rate-limit table, so free_limits stays unknown. Terms permit internal business use but also address third-party services; commercial use of the hosted free tier remains unconfirmed.
best_for: Permanently-free open models, no trial clock

name: Z.ai (Zhipu AI / GLM)
free_tier: GLM-4.5-Flash, GLM-4.7-Flash (text), and GLM-4.6V-Flash (vision) are officially listed as $0 cost (input, cached input, and output) on a permanent basis
rate_limits: Not specified with concrete RPM/TPM figures in public docs
notes: Terms of Use prohibit using Z.ai to "develop, train, or enhance any algorithms, models, or technologies that directly or indirectly compete with us" — otherwise general use, including commercial, isn't restricted
best_for: A permanently-free model with no trial clock

name: IBM watsonx.ai (Lite plan)
free_tier: Lite plan: 300,000 tokens/month for foundation model inference, 20 CUH/month for ML tooling, 100 pages/month of document text extraction
rate_limits: 2 inference requests per second (explicitly documented for the Lite plan)
notes: Lite plan doesn't support fine-tuning of foundation or custom models; 1-day idle deployment timeout. Never expires or bills while inside quota, but a payment method (with a nominal ~$1 authorization hold) is required at signup
best_for: Governed enterprise inference with a monthly free quota

name: OVHcloud AI Endpoints
free_tier: Ten models are currently listed as Free: three Olala-v1.0 text models (mini-7A1B, summarise, translate), two Qwen3Guard moderation models, Stable Diffusion XL (being retired, end of life 2027-02-10) and four NVIDIA Riva TTS voices; access is available anonymously or with an API key tied to a Public Cloud project
rate_limits: Anonymous access: 2 requests/min per IP per model. Authenticated (API key): 400 requests/min per project per model. Exceeding either returns HTTP 429
notes: Anonymous access uses no account, API key or signup phone; the 2 requests/min limit is per IP and model. Authenticated API keys require a Public Cloud project with a valid payment method. Commercial permission for the hosted free-model tier is not confirmed; individual model licences are separate. Sources: https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/public-cloud/ai-machine-learning/ai-endpoints-capabilities and https://docs.ovhcloud.com/en/guides/public-cloud/ai-machine-learning/ai-endpoints-getting-started (read 2026-11-25).
best_for: EU-hosted, no-account access to open models

name: Fireworks AI
free_tier: $1 trial credit
rate_limits: 10 requests/min with no payment method or no credits; 6,000 RPM account-wide maximum once a payment method and active credits are on file
notes: Fireworks uses prepaid credits. After the $1 credit is exhausted, add a payment method and credits (or enable auto top-up) to continue; account limits can rise with spend
best_for: Fast hosted open models to trial with $1

name: Baseten
free_tier: New workspaces receive credits for testing and deployment; Baseten does not publish the amount or an expiry and has no separate free tier
rate_limits: Model APIs default (models with combined token limits): Basic (unverified) 15 RPM / 100,000 TPM; Basic (verified) 120 RPM / 500,000 TPM; HTTP 429 when exceeded
notes: Baseten's billing docs (read 2026-11-25): "New workspaces receive credits for testing and deployment" and "Baseten doesn't offer a separate free tier or perpetual free plan"; neither page gives an amount or expiration, and the current pricing page no longer mentions the credits. Without a payment method, models are deactivated when the credits run out. Model APIs are priced per token; dedicated deployments are priced by compute time.
best_for: Free starter credits for evaluating hosted custom and open models

name: Novita AI
free_tier: $100 promotional credits for eligible Novita Agent Sandbox usage (CPU, RAM, storage), granted after an account-setup survey; Novita does not say they apply to Model API calls. No LLM on the pricing page is priced at $0
rate_limits: Per model, by account tier. New/low-spend accounts are Tier T1 (monthly top-ups <= $50): most models 50 RPM, some 30 RPM; most 50M TPM, a few 2M-5M TPM
notes: Novita's sandbox pricing doc (https://docs.novita.ai/guides/sandbox-pricing, read 2026-11-20) says new users who complete an account-setup survey receive "$100 in promotional credits for eligible Novita Sandbox usage", subject to a validity period it does not state; no official page read gives 90 days, and none says the credits apply to Model API calls. No credit card is required for the Sandbox credits. As of 2026-11-19 the pricing and models pages price every LLM above $0: Ling 3.1 Flash costs $0.3/$0.9 per 1M tokens, Apodex 1.1 Mini is no longer listed, and models labelled "Time limited free" still carry a price. Novita Terms of Service (updated August 5, 2026, re-read 2026-11-20) state that the Site and Marketplace Offerings may not be "exploited for any commercial purpose whatsoever, without our express prior written permission". T1 table read in a browser on 2026-11-20 (https://docs.novita.ai/guides/llm-rate-limits): 58 of 78 models at 50 RPM and 20 at 30 RPM; 74 at 50M TPM.
best_for: $100 credits for Novita Agent Sandbox

name: AI21 Labs
free_tier: $10 trial credit; AI21 gives its validity as three months in its docs and 7 days on its pricing page
rate_limits: Jamba Large/Mini: 10 RPS / 200 RPM on the AI21 Platform; higher limits on request
notes: No credit card is needed for the trial; billing details are required once the credit is used up or expires. AI21's docs (https://docs.ai21.com/docs/usage-cost) say the $10 credit is "good for three months", while https://www.ai21.com/pricing says "$10 credits for 7 days"; neither page is dated, so both are given (re-read 2026-11-20). Commercial terms: AI21 Terms of Service (https://www.ai21.com/terms-policies/terms-of-use/, read 2026-11-20) grant use “solely for your internal business or development purposes”, but §5 defines a free trial as an “Evaluation Product” and §5.3 states Evaluation Products are provided “FOR YOUR INTERNAL EVALUATION ONLY” — so the $10 trial credit does not permit production/commercial use.
best_for: Jamba long-context models on a $10 trial

name: NLP Cloud
free_tier: $15 trial credit
rate_limits: Pay-as-you-go (with the $15 free credit): 10 parallel requests (can be increased); the pricing table's Free plan lists 2 parallel requests. No RPM/TPM published for free access: every per-model requests-per-minute row on the Free plan says "Variable"
notes: Corrected: the official registration page does not ask for a phone number, contradicting the earlier listing The pricing page (read in a browser on 2026-11-20) says "Automatically get a $15 FREE credit" and "Parallel requests: 10 (can be increased)".
best_for: NLP tasks (NER, classification, summarization) on a $15 trial

name: Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio)
free_tier: Typically 1,000,000 tokens per model for new users, Singapore region (International deployment scope) only; qwen-plus, qwen-flash and qwen-turbo no longer carry a free quota for new users
rate_limits: Per-model, account-level limits (International): e.g. qwen-plus 600 RPM / 1,000,000 TPM; qwen-flash 600 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM; qwen3.6-plus and qwen3.7-plus 15,000 RPM / 5,000,000 TPM. HTTP 429 when a limit is exceeded; HTTP 403 when the free quota is exhausted
notes: Covers real-time inference only; excludes batch invocation, fine-tuning, model deployment, custom models, PAI-DSW and OSS fees. Account information must be completed before activation. One quota per account (shared with RAM users); re-registering does not grant a new one. Commercial terms: Model Studio Service Agreement (https://terms.alicdn.com/legal-agreement/terms/common_platform_service/20230728213935489/20230728213935489.html, effective 2026-09-02, read 2026-11-22) contemplates developing apps and providing services to others (§4.3.3) and tells users to evaluate carefully before external commercial use (§7.6); it prohibits only reselling the service and training competing products (§4.6), and its free-quota clauses (§3.2.3, §4.7) set no evaluation-only limit. But the service-specific terms (https://help.aliyun.com/en/model-studio/bailian-service-notes, read 2026-11-22) §III.4 and the Trial Features note §5 restrict content generated through 'model trials' to evaluating model performance, 'not for any other purpose, including any commercial purpose' — scoped to trial/experience entrances (Experience Plaza), while the free-quota page (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/new-free-quota, read 2026-11-22) itself calls the quota a 'free trial' and the pricing page (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing, read 2026-11-22) says nothing about commercial or production use. No official sentence settles whether the evaluation-only restriction attaches to free-quota API calls, so commercial_ok remains null.
best_for: Qwen models with a large free token quota (Singapore region)

name: Modal
free_tier: $30/month recurring credit (Starter plan)
rate_limits: Starter: 100 containers + 10 GPU concurrency, 5 crons, 1-day log retention
notes: Recurring monthly credit, not a one-time trial. Modal is serverless compute you deploy models on, not a hosted model API. A payment method on file is required to use Modal at all. Commercial terms: Modal Terms of Service (https://modal.com/legal/terms, effective May 2026, re-read 2026-11-24) authorize use «solely for Customer's internal business» (reselling direct access prohibited, §1.3), but Section 1.2 states «No-Fee Use» «may be subject to certain additional restrictions, limitations and differing terms» as specified in the corresponding «No-Fee Use Limitations», which Modal does not publish on modal.com; the pricing page (https://modal.com/pricing, read 2026-11-24) describes Starter ($0 + compute, $30/month free credits) as built for «small teams and independent developers» without granting or denying commercial use of the credit. No official sentence settles it, so commercial_ok remains null. The $30 Starter credit covers compute only: the pricing FAQ (read 2026-11-24) says free usage of Modal's own Model APIs is not part of the Starter plan, effective 2026-09-01.
best_for: Self-hosting open models on free monthly GPU credit

name: SambaNova Cloud
free_tier: Rate-limited free tier (applies when no payment method is linked) across the models listed in the Free Tier table
rate_limits: Free Tier: 20 RPM / 20 RPD / 200,000 TPD listed per model in the table (gpt-oss-120b, gemma-4-31B-it), enforcement scope not stated; Developer Tier (card required): 60 RPM / 12,000 RPD per model, 20M tokens per day across all models
notes: Free Tier applies when no payment method is linked to the account. Commercial use: the SambaCloud ToS grant a commercial license with no evaluation-only clause, but the rate-limits doc (https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits, read 2026-11-24) says all SambaCloud models are Preview models, «intended for evaluation purposes and developer experimentation only» and «should not be used in production environments»; as for other providers whose own pages restrict free use to evaluation (nvidia-nim, cohere), commercial_ok is false. The previously-listed "$5 / 3 months" trial could not be re-confirmed on official pages (2026-07-30). card_required is unconfirmed because SambaNova's own pages disagree (read 2026-11-24): the rate-limits doc (https://docs.sambanova.ai/docs/en/models/rate-limits) says "Free Tier: Applied when there is no payment method linked with your account", while the plans page (https://cloud.sambanova.ai/plans) says "Add a payment method and purchase credits to run your first requests". Settling it needs a real signup, which has not been done. The rate-limits doc (read 2026-11-24) lists only gpt-oss-120b and gemma-4-31B-it on the Free Tier; DeepSeek-V3.1, Meta-Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and DeepSeek-V3.2 are no longer listed there. All SambaCloud models are Preview models, "intended for evaluation purposes and developer experimentation only", with limited capacity and removable at short notice.
best_for: Fast open models on a rate-limited free tier

name: Scaleway Generative APIs
free_tier: 1,000,000 tokens free + 60 min Whisper transcription; billing starts at token 1,000,001
rate_limits: With a validated payment method: 300 RPM / 200k TPM per model; 600 RPM and higher TPM once identity is verified
notes: European provider (France). Free allowance is a one-time token bucket, not time-limited. Official rate limits apply once a valid payment method is registered; identity verification raises them. Free tier and limits read in a browser on 2026-11-20: the pricing page ("free tier: 1 million tokens and 60 minutes of audio transcription") and the Organization quotas docs (300 RPM / 200k TPM with a validated payment method, 600 RPM and higher TPM once identity is validated).
best_for: EU-hosted open models with 1M free tokens

name: NVIDIA NIM
free_tier: Free API credits for prototyping on NVIDIA-hosted NIM endpoints, with an NVIDIA Developer Program account; no credit amount is published
rate_limits: Not published by the provider
notes: NVIDIA's NIM FAQ (https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/docs/faq) says you can "sign up for free credits to access NVIDIA-hosted endpoints for application prototyping"; it publishes no credit amount, rate limit or expiry. The NIM page (https://developer.nvidia.com/nim) says Developer Program membership enables the hosted APIs "for development and testing" and points production use to NVIDIA AI Enterprise (both read 2026-11-20). NVIDIA's API Trial Terms of Service, now published as a PDF (https://assets.ngc.nvidia.com/products/api-catalog/legal/NVIDIA%20API%20Trial%20Terms%20of%20Service.pdf, read 2026-11-20), say the credits are "for trial purposes only" and that without a subscription "you may only use the API Service for internal testing and evaluation purposes, not in production" (section 1.4). Neither page publishes a credit amount or rate limits, so the earlier 40 requests/min and 10,000 requests/day figures and the phone and card requirements are not confirmed.
best_for: Trialling NVIDIA-optimized models (evaluation only)

name: Vercel AI Gateway
free_tier: Free tier: a monthly free credit covering a subset of models (Free Tier eligible models) at lower rate limits
rate_limits: No numeric free-tier limit published: the free tier has a lower per-model limit than paid (HTTP 429 when exceeded); Vercel documents behavior, not numbers
notes: A monthly free credit is stated in Vercel's docs (https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/pricing, read 2026-10-09); the amount is not stated there. Once you purchase credits, your account moves to the paid tier and the monthly free credit no longer applies. BYOK is not available on the free tier. It routes requests to many providers rather than hosting models itself. models_free is a sample, not the full list: the first language model, by id, of each of the first eight providers in alphabetical order among the models flagged availableToFreeTier in the page data of https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models, joined with type language in https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/models and excluding priority-tier variants (isFast) and the synthetic free copy (isSyntheticFreeTier) (131 such models from 30 providers, read 2026-10-09T03:00Z; the catalogue changes). We did not verify that the rendered ?freeTier=true filter matches that field. Five models priced at zero that spend no credit are tagged free in the API: convaiinnovations/laya, convaiinnovations/laya-free (evaluation type, not chat), inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash, inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash-free and poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free.
best_for: One key across many providers with a free monthly credit

name: Jina AI
free_tier: 10M free tokens per new API key, usable across all models — embeddings, rerankers, classifier; plus a keyless Reader (r.jina.ai) for basic use
rate_limits: Free key: 100 RPM / 100k TPM for embeddings & reranker; Reader 20 RPM keyless, 500 RPM with a free key
notes: The 10M-token balance is a one-time grant that does not replenish; the keyless Reader is genuinely ongoing. Hosted API is commercial-OK and data is not used for training. No card required.
best_for: Free embeddings & rerank behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: Deepgram
free_tier: $200 free credit on signup (no card, no expiration) — Nova speech-to-text and Aura text-to-speech at pay-as-you-go rates
rate_limits: STT pre-recorded up to 50 concurrent; STT streaming up to 150; TTS REST up to 15; TTS streaming up to 45
notes: No card and no expiration on the credit. Data catch: the Model Improvement Program is opt-OUT — send mip_opt_out=true per request to keep your data out of training. Native REST/WebSocket API, not OpenAI-compatible. Concurrency for Pay as you go confirmed on https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/api-rate-limits (2026-11-20).
best_for: Biggest free credit here, for speech (STT/TTS)

name: AssemblyAI
free_tier: $50 free signup credit for pre-recorded and real-time speech-to-text and Speech Understanding; LLM Gateway is excluded
rate_limits: Free tier: 5 parallel transcriptions; 5 new streaming sessions/min (no auto-scaling); 20,000 HTTP requests per 5 minutes; transcript polling: 60 requests/min per API key and transcript ID
notes: One-time credit, not renewing. The OpenAI-compatible LLM Gateway at https://llm-gateway.assemblyai.com/v1 is paid from the first request and excluded from the $50 credit; no OpenAI-compatible endpoint is confirmed for this free offer. Free users cannot opt out of the model improvement program. The default speech model differs between free and paid accounts; set speech_models explicitly before upgrading. Billing docs (2026-11-20): "New accounts receive $50 in free credits for Pre-recorded STT, Real-time STT, and Speech Understanding" and "LLM Gateway is not included in the free tier"; limits from the pre-recorded rate-limits page.
best_for: Free speech-to-text and speech understanding

name: Mixedbread
free_tier: Starter plan: $5 one-time credit (no card) — embeddings (mxbai-embed-large-v1), reranking, and multimodal search over PDF/image/doc/code
rate_limits: Starter plan: 100 queries/min and 6,000 uploads/min
notes: Free credit is usage-based and non-renewing; usage-based pricing applies afterward. Native REST API, not documented as OpenAI-compatible. No card required.
best_for: No-card embeddings & rerank credit

name: AI Horde
free_tier: Free crowdsourced text & image generation; anonymous API key '0000000000' (no registration), or register to earn kudos for priority
rate_limits: Queue-based priority via kudos (no fixed daily quota); the official service reference gives 2/second and 90/minute per address on ordinary submit routes, 60/minute per address, method and concrete path for native text/chat status polling, and a stored account concurrency default of 30; the anonymous key gets the lowest queue priority
notes: Community-powered volunteer network — model availability and speed vary with worker supply, so it is not a fixed-SLA service. No card, no phone. Kudos never expire and cannot be sold. Commercial use is conditional: each model carries its own licence (aihorde.net UI displays 'Commercial use: allowed' or 'Pick something else if you plan to sell what you make or use it in a business'), and the official AI Horde FAQ (https://aihorde.net/faq/) says paid services built on the API must give back to the Horde at least as much as they take.
best_for: Anonymous, no-signup free generation (variable speed)
commercial_ok_condition: Per-model licence (some models forbid commercial use), and paid services using the API must give back to the Horde at least as much as they take.

name: ModelScope (API-Inference)
free_tier: Free API-Inference calls paid with daily 'Magicubes': 200/day for signing in + 50/day after linking an Alibaba Cloud account (do not roll over); calls cost ~0.5 / 1 / 2 Magicubes for lightweight / standard / flagship models
rate_limits: Bounded by the daily Magicubes: ~250/day from signing in and linking an Alibaba Cloud account, plus any earned by other actions (~125-500 calls depending on model tier); concurrency dynamically limited, single concurrency guaranteed
notes: Alibaba's model hub — a different product from Alibaba Model Studio. Requires a ModelScope account bound to an Alibaba Cloud account with real-name (ID) verification — a practical barrier for non-China users. Explicitly non-commercial ("for developers to experience"). No card. The Magicube (魔粒) amounts and per-call costs are on https://www.modelscope.cn/docs/magicube/intro (2026-11-20); API-Inference requires a bound, real-name-verified Alibaba Cloud account.
best_for: Free daily calls to many open models (Alibaba Cloud real-name verification required)

name: Pollinations.ai
free_tier: Quest balance: create an account, complete eligible Quests and claim what you earn from the dashboard (no credit card); a regular model uses the Quest balance when it can cover the estimated charge, otherwise the paid balance, and paid-only models (such as 3D) require the paid balance. No anonymous/no-key generation — every generation endpoint requires an API key; prices depend on the model. Text, image, video, audio, embeddings and 3D models behind one OpenAI-compatible API
rate_limits: No per-request rate limits for sk_ keys; usage is bounded by the balance. Since 2026-11-01 a pk_ key only identifies an app, and requests that send one get HTTP 401
notes: The old anonymous 1 req/15s and Seed 1 req/5s tiers (and the watermark/nologo scheme) are gone from the current docs; the API moved to gen.pollinations.ai with keys from enter.pollinations.ai. Quest availability and reward amounts change (the dashboard and the linked issue are the source of truth). No credit card needed to try. Paid-only models require Paid Pollen. Commercial use is conditional on each model's licence: section 8 of the Terms of Service (https://pollinations.ai/terms, last updated 2026-11-17, read 2026-11-24) says "Model licences vary; verify before commercial use." The terms do not name the Quest balance separately; the same clause covers all hosted access. The previous docs_url pointed at the stale master branch; the default branch is main. Wallet and Quest rules from the FAQ at https://enter.pollinations.ai (read in a browser on 2026-11-20).
best_for: OpenAI-compatible multi-modal API funded by Quest balance (no card)
commercial_ok_condition: Allowed subject to each model's licence; Pollinations says to verify the licence before commercial use.

name: Runware
free_tier: $2 in free credits for new users who sign up with a business email, "to explore the platform and test various models" (the pages do not tie it to a specific API)
rate_limits: Per-organization REST rate limit counted in results per second (number not published; "sits far above typical traffic"); no hard concurrency limit (2-4 concurrent requests recommended)
notes: The $2 requires signup with a business email; no credit card required. Commercial use of Outputs is allowed, subject to each model's licence (Partner Models are cleared for commercial use by Runware). Third-party provider models are subject to those providers' own rate limits.
best_for: Fast image models with a $2 no-card credit

name: Pinecone Inference
free_tier: Starter base allowance: 5M embedding tokens/month per model (llama-text-embed-v2, multilingual-e5-large, pinecone-sparse-english-v0) and 500 rerank requests/month for bge-reranker-v2-m3; temporary promotions excluded
rate_limits: Starter: 5M embedding tokens/mo per model; 250K embedding tokens/min per model (passage); 500 rerank requests/mo and 60 rerank requests/min per model; 100 inference requests/s and 2,000/min per project
notes: Base allowances only: the temporary embedding-token increase through 2026-12-31 is excluded. Monthly quotas are hard limits (429 on exhaustion). name: Twelve Labs (Marengo Embed)

rate_limits: Free plan: Marengo 3.5 Embed video/audio 3,000 RPD, 25 RPM; embed text/image 3,000 RPD, 600 RPM; Analyze 1,000 RPD, 60 RPM
notes: No credit card for the Free plan, but indexed data expires after 90 days unless upgraded. Marengo produces multimodal embeddings. Not OpenAI-compatible. On 2026-11-19 the pricing page did not list the Marengo/Pegasus free allowances or the 600 indexing minutes; its Free column shows 3 GB of storage and a "Basic" workload. Rate limits from https://docs.twelvelabs.io/v1.3/docs/get-started/plans-and-billing/rate-limits/new-billing (2026-11-20); the earlier "600 minutes of indexing" figure is a per-hour duration limit, not a free total.
best_for: Free multimodal (video/audio/image/text) embeddings

name: OCR.space
free_tier: 25,000 conversions/month (Engine 1 & 2) plus 1,000 Engine 3 conversions/month; max 1 MB file, PDFs up to 3 pages

name: LlamaParse (LlamaCloud)
free_tier: Pay-as-you-go: 10,000 free credits every month; Fast parsing uses 1 credit/page (up to 10,000 pages before add-ons).
rate_limits: Pay-as-you-go: 5 concurrent parse jobs; 1 project.
notes: Pay-as-you-go overage: $1.50 per 1,000 credits. Parse tiers cost 1/3/10/25 credits per page (Fast/Cost-effective/Agentic/Agentic Plus); layout adds 3 credits/page and extraction is charged separately. Re-parsing cached files costs no credits.
best_for: Free document parsing for RAG (~10k pages/mo)

name: Nanonets
free_tier: $50 in free credits on signup (one-time) across data-extraction / OCR workflows
rate_limits: Not published by the provider
notes: One-time signup credit, not renewing (credits never expire); no credit card required to start. Paid plans start at $100/month afterwards.
best_for: Document extraction on a $50 no-card credit

name: Moondream Cloud
free_tier: $5/month usage credits in every workspace (Free plan) for the Moondream vision model — caption, query (VQA), detect, point
rate_limits: 2 requests/sec on the free tier (10 req/sec with ≥$10 account balance); usage bounded by the $5/month credit
notes: Last updated 2025-12-10. Commercial use of the free tier is unclear: §4.1 permits use for «internal business or personal purposes», while §4.2 prohibits «commercially exploit the Service or any portion of the Service». The terms do not explicitly clarify whether commercial use is permitted on the free tier.
best_for: Tiny vision model, OpenAI-compatible, monthly free credit

name: Speechmatics
free_tier: $100 in free credits on signup (no payment card), one balance across Speech-to-Text, add-ons and Text-to-Speech; Text-to-Speech lists the first 1 million characters free
rate_limits: Free: 2 concurrent real-time sessions; Batch API: 10 new jobs/s and 50 job-status requests/s (bounded by the $100 credit)
notes: One-time $100 credit grant, no card required; to go beyond it, add a card and move to Pro (pay-as-you-go). Accounts created before 1 August 2026 received a one-time $25 transition credit. No data logging for model training by default. Terms of Service 3.1 licenses the Software to produce Integrated Products, 4.4 only bars reselling the Software as a standalone product, and 10.3 assigns to the customer all rights in the Transcripts; Free Usage (5.1) is part of the same terms, and no clause limits it to evaluation or non-commercial use. The pricing page (2026-11-19) confirms 2 concurrent real-time sessions on Free; the batch figures above are not on it.
best_for: High-accuracy STT + TTS on a $100 no-card credit

name: Speechify API
free_tier: 500K characters/month TTS (hard cap; pauses until next month), catalog voices, streaming and SSML; Simba 3.5 drops to 333K characters/month from 2026-11-21 (Simba 3.0/3.2 stay at 500K)
rate_limits: Free: 3 concurrent requests, 1 request/s sustained (burst 10); hard monthly cap, no top-ups
notes: Commercial use is allowed on the free tier. No credit card required. Free cannot top up and pauses when the monthly balance runs out. Voice cloning is paid-plan only; voice agents are now an enterprise-only product (no free minutes).
best_for: Free commercial TTS (500K chars/mo)

name: Unreal Speech
free_tier: 250,000 characters TTS (~6 hours of audio) on the Free plan; the pricing page does not say whether the allowance is monthly
rate_limits: No rate limit published in the current V8 API docs (legacy v7 docs listed 2 requests/second on Free). Per-request size: /stream up to 1,000 characters, /speech up to 3,000, /synthesisTasks up to 500,000
notes: Commercial use allowed, but free-plan users must attribute Unreal Speech with a link when publishing audio. First-party REST endpoints. No credit card required.
best_for: Largest free TTS (250k chars/mo, attribution)

name: ElevenLabs
free_tier: 10,000 credits/month shared across Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text and more (~10 min TTS/month)
rate_limits: Free plan concurrency: 2 requests (Multilingual v2), 4 (Flash), 8 (Speech to Text), 6 (Realtime Speech to Text)
notes: The free tier is NON-COMMERCIAL only per the Terms of Use (commercial license starts on paid Starter, $6/mo); non-commercial use requires a personal email address. Free-plan credits do not roll over. API access is available on the free plan. No credit card to sign up.
best_for: Best-known TTS voices (free tier is non-commercial)

name: Sarvam AI
free_tier: ₹100 in free credits for verified users on signup, usable across any API including chat completion (Sarvam-105B) and speech (STT/TTS); credits never expire
rate_limits: Published Pay as you go limits: Sarvam-105B and sarvam-105b-conversations 60 req/min; gemma4, glm5.3 and deepseekv4.1-flash-1017 50 req/min. STT real-time REST and TTS REST/HTTP streaming 60 req/min; STT WebSocket 20 concurrent; TTS WebSocket 60 concurrent. Signup-credit plan assignment is not explicitly stated.
notes: One-time signup credit shared across all APIs; credits never expire. Sarvam-M has been deprecated (use Sarvam-105B). Signup credits carry commercial production rights for generated Output. Card/phone requirement not stated in the docs. The docs list limits per plan but do not explicitly assign signup-credit accounts to Pay as you go. India-focused provider (pricing in INR), strong Indic-language models. The five sampled serverless model IDs share the /v2 OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The model-specific documentation says sarvam-105b-conversations uses /v1 only, so it is excluded from this shared-endpoint sample. Gemma 4, GLM-5.3 Flash and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash accept image input. Sources: https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/token-factory/models and https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/token-factory/models/sarvam-105b (read 2026-11-14).
best_for: Indic-language chat + speech via one OpenAI-compatible key

name: Gladia
free_tier: €50 signup credits valid for one year: approximately 312 async hours on Solaria-3, 185 async hours on Solaria-1, or 73 real-time hours at current rates
rate_limits: 30 real-time and 25 async concurrent requests (Self-serve pay-as-you-go plan that carries the €50 credit)
notes: One-time grant with no monthly reset; prepaid model: top up once the credit is consumed. General Terms of Use (Gladia Inc, https://www.gladia.io/general-terms-of-use-gladia-inc, read 2026-10-17) section 7 licenses Output solely for «internal, personal and commercial purposes», but conditions the licence on «payment of all applicable fees» and does not mention free credits or trials, so commercial use of the signup credit is unconfirmed. Card requirement not explicitly stated on the pricing page.
best_for: High-accuracy async + real-time transcription to trial

name: Rime
free_tier: $50 of free usage every month across every Rime model; no credit card required; unused free usage does not roll over
rate_limits: $50/month usage allowance; concurrency limits apply, but the numeric limit for the current Free plan is unconfirmed
notes: Free usage renews monthly; move to Flex to continue after the allowance runs out. Commercial use remains unconfirmed: the October 29, 2026 terms describe Free as evaluation and development and prohibit Caller audio, PHI and third-party personal data, despite pricing marketing real calls. Section 6.3 permits training on Free Plan Training Data, excluding Voice Recordings, natural-person voice audio and third-party personal data; its license survives termination and excludes submissions after upgrade. Paid-plan trials count as paid plans. The older August 22, 2025 privacy policy (https://www.rime.ai/privacy) says no training unless explicitly requested and agreed. The training policy remains unresolved; no fixed Free Plan Training Data retention is confirmed. Sources read 2026-11-17: https://rime.ai/pricing and https://www.rime.ai/terms.
best_for: Low-latency conversational TTS to prototype

name: Tencent Hunyuan
free_tier: One-time TokenHub new-user trial (Hunyuan has moved to TokenHub): 1,000,000 free tokens for each language model and each multimodal-understanding model; each model's package can be claimed once per account and the quota applies at main-account level; the offer runs until 2026-12-31, after which Tencent says the arrangement may continue or be adjusted. The legacy Hunyuan free package (1,000,000 tokens shared across text/vision models plus 1,000,000 for Hunyuan-embedding) is no longer offered: the old platform stopped new purchases on 2026-06-30
rate_limits: ChatCompletions (Tencent Cloud API): default 5 concurrent requests per account; GetEmbedding: 5 requests/second (both still marked pre-offline, expected 2026-12-21, on pages updated 2026-09-23 and re-read 2026-11-24). A limit of 20 requests/second for the other Hunyuan APIs is not stated on any official API page checked on 2026-10-15, so it is not confirmed
notes: Tencent has moved Hunyuan to TokenHub, its model-service platform. Per Tencent's migration notice, the legacy platform stopped new purchases on 2026-06-30, and its console and APIs were due to close on 2026-09-30; the legacy ChatCompletions and GetEmbedding API pages (updated 2026-09-23) still list an expected shutdown of 2026-12-21, so the two official sources disagree. The four vision models in the old free package (Tencent HY Vision 1.5 Instruct, hunyuan-turbos-vision, hunyuan-t1-vision, hunyuan-turbos-vision-video) left the old platform on 2026-06-22. TokenHub trial: the free quota is used first, unused quota expires, and once it runs out calls stop unless post-paid billing is enabled. The new-user free package page (the docs_url, updated 2026-11-16, re-read 2026-11-24) gives 1,000,000 tokens with a validity of 1 year for all language models and for all multimodal-understanding models, counted from the day the quota is claimed (the page says 免费额度从领取时起算), after which the unused part expires; the 3-month validity in Tencent's migration notice applies only to the separate free quota for users who complete the migration from the old platform. The same page adds that the validity differs between models, so check the model you plan to use. TokenHub requires Tencent Cloud real-name verification, per its quick start (cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130058, updated 2026-11-13) — a practical barrier for many non-China users. openai_base_url is TokenHub's OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the legacy endpoint (api.hunyuan.cloud.tencent.com/v1) belongs to the closed platform. Tencent documents the same two hosts under two domains, one per documentation site: the China site (cloud.tencent.com/document/product/1823/130078, updated 2026-11-16) lists tokenhub.tencentmaas.com (Guangzhou) and tokenhub-intl.tencentmaas.com (Singapore), plus backup hosts under tencentmaas.cn for when the default is unavailable, and calls must use the endpoint of the region where the service was activated; the international site (www.tencentcloud.com/document/product/1300/80632, updated 2026-11-16, AI-translated and reviewed) lists tokenhub.tencentcloudmaas.com and tokenhub-intl.tencentcloudmaas.com, and a Silicon Valley host (tokenhub-us.tencentcloudmaas.tech). This entry uses the first, as the China-site quick start does. China-site and international pages re-read 2026-11-24. Commercial-use terms not stated.
best_for: Chinese-language LLM workloads via an OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: Voyage AI
free_tier: 200M free tokens per model on current embedding models (voyage-4-large, voyage-4, voyage-4-lite, voyage-context-4, voyage-code-4); the pricing page is inconsistent about which rerankers get 200M free tokens (its table lists rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite); voyage-multimodal-3.5 and voyage-multimodal-3 get 200M text tokens + 150B pixels; legacy voyage-finance-2, voyage-law-2 and voyage-code-2 get 50M — a one-time complimentary allotment per account
rate_limits: No numeric limit published for accounts without a payment method. With a payment method (Tier 1, free tokens still apply), per model: voyage-4 / voyage-code-4 8M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-large / voyage-context-4 3M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-4-lite 16M TPM, 2,000 RPM; voyage-multimodal-3.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3 / rerank-2.5 2M TPM, 2,000 RPM; rerank-3-lite / rerank-2.5-lite 4M TPM, 2,000 RPM. HTTP 429 on exceed
notes: The allotment is a one-time complimentary balance per model, not a renewing monthly quota. Free tokens do not apply to Batch API usage. Voyage's pricing page is internally inconsistent on rerankers: the prose still names the rerank-2.5/rerank-2 families as free, while the price table gives 200M free tokens to rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite and lists rerank-2.5 under older models with no free tokens. No credit card required to claim. Owned by MongoDB — a first-party model provider, not a proxy. On 2026-11-19 the pricing page disagreed on rerankers: its table lists rerank-3 and rerank-3-lite with 200M free tokens, while its prose names rerank-2.5/2 and its older-models section says those get no free tokens. Tier 1 limits confirmed on https://docs.voyageai.com/docs/rate-limits (2026-11-20).
best_for: Best-in-class embeddings and reranking with a large free allotment

name: Contextual AI

rate_limits: Not published by the provider (Rerank requests capped at 400,000 tokens each)

The restriction on commercially exploiting the Services applies "Except as expressly permitted hereunder", which we read as covering resale of the Services themselves, not use in your own applications.
best_for: A strong instruction-following reranker to try for free

name: Fish Audio
free_tier: App Free plan: 8,000 credits/month (~7 min, up to 500 characters per generation). API: the s2.1-pro-free TTS model is priced at $0 (pay-as-you-go API, no subscription); the docs no longer state an end date or fair-use limits
rate_limits: API: 5 concurrent requests (Starter tier, <$100 paid). App Free plan: 500 characters per generation, 8,000 credits/month

On 2026-11-19 the pricing docs listed s2.1-pro-free at $0 but no longer stated the 2026-11-30 end date or the fair-use limits.

The Free plan allows 500 characters per generation for text to speech and the API, and its videos are watermarked (https://www.camb.ai/pricing, read 2026-11-25). Card and commercial terms not stated on the pricing page.

Extraction/OCR supports tables, key-value data and handwriting. Commercial-use eligibility remains unconfirmed.

rate_limits: 1,000 sandbox calls/month; 10 one-time production calls
notes: No credit card required. Sandbox output is watermarked (for testing); the 10 production calls return clean output. Image editing/generation (AI backgrounds, relighting, shadows). The terms license Free Accounts for personal, non-commercial purposes only.

name: Poolside
free_tier: Free developer API key via Poolside Platform for Poolside's Laguna coding models (current lineup: Laguna S 2.1, Laguna XS 2.1, Laguna M.1); which models and limits apply to the free key is not documented
rate_limits: Not published

(https://platform.poolside.ai, read 2026-11-24). The docs still offer a free key ("Looking for the fastest way to get a free Poolside API key? Choose Use Poolside Platform for free (recommended).", https://docs.poolside.ai/get-started/log-in) and https://poolside.ai/models still says "Free to use for a limited time" (both read 2026-11-24). Whether free hosted access still works after 31 October 2026 could not be confirmed, so the entry is unverified. No card was required at signup when last confirmed (2026-08); the current pages do not mention it.

name: Upstage
free_tier: Free credits for new API accounts, amount not published (Upstage's FAQ mentions free credits; the $10 figure is no longer on its docs or pricing page) — Solar LLM (chat + embeddings) plus Document Parse / OCR / information extraction; basic testing needs no login or card; Studio document agents include 10 free runs each
rate_limits: Tier 0 (below the Explore commitment tier): Solar Pro 4 100 RPM / 250,000 TPM; Solar Mini 4 100 RPM / 250,000 TPM (50,000 TPM on legacy tiers); Embeddings 100 RPM / 300,000 TPM; Document OCR 3 requests/second, 500 pages/minute
notes: The Solar Pro 4 free window (2026-08-05 to 2026-08-11) has ended; standard pricing is $0.30 input / $1.20 output per 1M tokens from 2026-10-11 (UTC), after a 70%-off phase that runs until 2026-10-10. As of 2026-11-19 the getting-started, pricing and FAQ pages (https://console.upstage.ai/docs/resources/faq) publish no signup-credit amount; the FAQ says "You will not be billed upon registering a payment method as long as you have free credits available" and "No login or credit card is required for basic testing." Beyond the free credits, API use is pay-per-use, with prepaid commitment tiers from $100/mo adding bonus credit and higher limits. Studio agent runs need no card. A separate institutional grant (up to 1 year of free Solar Pro + Document Parse) exists for eligible schools, hospitals and nonprofits only. Solar Pro 2/3 and Solar Mini are deprecated on 2026-10-30 (KST). Data policy evidence: Terms of Use (effective 2026-11-30, revised 2026-11-23; the version effective 2026-09-21 applies until 2026-11-29), Article 22(6): data generated through "Services provided free of charge (excluding services temporarily provided free of charge for promotional purposes in anticipation of paid services)" "may be used for service provision and improvement, as well as for research and development of artificial intelligence technologies (including training)", and Members permit that use. Article 22(5) otherwise excludes training without separate consent, and Article 15(1) says free credits are given under promotional policies; the Getting Started page says Upstage does not store or reuse data sent to its APIs. Privacy Policy, Free Tier API row: "Until the end of service provision or a separately notified period." Whether the signup credit counts as the promotional exception is not stated, so trains_on_prompts stays null (unconfirmed) and only the retention is recorded. Terms read 2026-11-25: https://www.upstage.ai/terms-of-service ; privacy policy read 2026-10-13: https://www.upstage.ai/privacy-policy/updated-aug-26-2026
best_for: Solar LLM + document OCR behind one OpenAI-compatible key

rate_limits: 100 documents/month on the free plan

best_for: Free-forever document OCR (100 docs/mo, no card)

notes: No credit card required to start — an explicit $50 platform credit on signup; afterwards cloud STT is billed at $0.00020/second of audio (6-second minimum per request). Commercial terms not stated on the pricing page. Native STT REST API. The former /pricing URL now redirects to /developers. Default limits confirmed on https://support.voicegain.ai/hc/en-us/articles/4411882926868-Rate-Limiting (read in a browser on 2026-11-20).

name: Smallest.ai (Waves)
free_tier: $10 in free credits with full access on Pay As You Go — TTS (Lightning v3.1), STT (Pulse) and voice agents; speech-to-speech (Hydra) is beta/request-access
rate_limits: Pay As You Go: 15 concurrent TTS streams, 100 TTS requests/min, 450M chars/month cap; 100 concurrent STT streams; 20 concurrent agent calls (bounded by the $10 credit)

The models table shows Voice Cloning 'No' for Pay As You Go although the TTS card advertises instant cloning. Pricing page (https://www.retellai.com/pricing) advertises full platform access.

name: Datalab (Marker / Surya)
free_tier: One-time credit for the hosted document AI API: $10 at signup plus $10 more after adding a card with a work email; $5 plus $5 with a personal email. The credit does not expire
rate_limits: Free: 25 requests/min and 25 concurrent requests (the limits docs and the pricing page agree)
notes: The signup half of the credit needs no card; the second half requires adding one. Accounts created before the one-time credit keep their monthly usage allowance through 2026-11-30. The docs home page still says new accounts include $5 in free credits, which does not match the billing and pricing pages. Commercial permission for the hosted free credit remains unconfirmed; self-hosted model licence conditions are separate. The public pages do not say whether signup needs a phone. Sources: https://documentation.datalab.to/platform/billing, https://documentation.datalab.to/docs/common/limits and https://www.datalab.to/pricing (read 2026-11-24)
best_for: Open-source-pedigree OCR (Marker/Surya) on a non-expiring free credit

name: W&B Inference
free_tier: Free plan with a default $100/month spending cap; each plan includes an Inference allowance, but no Free amount is published (the pricing page shows "Free credit for a limited time" on the Pro plan, not on Free)
rate_limits: No RPM/TPM published; per-project and per-user concurrency limits (HTTP 429 when exceeded); default spending cap $100/month on the Free tier
notes: W&B Inference is now documented as CoreWeave Forge Serverless Inference (docs.wandb.ai redirects to docs.coreweave.com). The $100/month figure is a default spending cap, not a stated free-credit amount. When credits run out, Free accounts must activate pay-as-you-go on the Billing tab or upgrade; CoreWeave requires prepayment for paid access. Available only from supported geographic locations. OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.inference.wandb.ai/v1; API keys are created at forge.coreweave.com. The pricing page lists "$5/mo free credit for a limited time" only under Pro and "Billed monthly" under Free, so the Free amount is unclear.
best_for: Open-weight frontier models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, GLM, GPT-OSS) behind one unified API with Weave tracing

name: Typhoon (SCB 10X)
free_tier: Free to use research showcase API — all Typhoon models at $0
rate_limits: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct: 5 requests/second, 200 requests/minute; typhoon-ocr: 2 requests/second, 20 requests/minute; typhoon-asr-realtime: 100 requests/minute
notes: By SCB 10X, the venture arm of Siam Commercial Bank, focused on Thai-language models. The free catalog spans LLMs (typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct), OCR (typhoon-ocr family) and realtime Thai ASR (typhoon-asr-realtime, typhoon-isan-asr-realtime) — the hosted API is OpenAI-compatible, including audio transcriptions. Beta, provided as-is with no formal support; usage data is collected to improve the model; SCB claims no rights in outputs. Sign up for a free API key at opentyphoon.ai.
best_for: Thai-language LLMs, OCR and speech via an OpenAI-compatible research API

name: Regolo.ai
free_tier: 30-day free trial with full access to all Core chat models, capped at 1M tokens per day; no credit card required
rate_limits: 1M tokens/day during the trial; "Stricter rate limits" and fair-usage throttling apply (no figures published)
notes: Italian/EU provider (operated by Seeweb): processing stays under European jurisdiction and the provider states zero data retention. The 30-day free plan is for new subscribers and can be used once per subscriber. After 30 days the account moves to Pay-as-you-Go with no automatic charge. The daily allowance is spent with a per-model usage multiplier, so larger models use it faster. The terms regulate resale per plan (allowed on Pay-Per-Token, not on flat-rate plans without authorization) and do not mention the free plan in that clause, so commercial use of the free plan is not settled. No phone requirement or rate-limit figures are published. Pricing page, zero-data-retention page and terms read 2026-11-24.
best_for: EU-hosted open models with zero data retention, for a month

name: Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (express mode)
free_tier: 90-day free tier for new Google Cloud users: an API key and the express-mode Gemini models within free-tier quotas, no billing information
rate_limits: 10 requests/min each for gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, gemini-2.5-flash-lite and gemini-2.5-flash-image; Gemini 3.x models listed as "Dynamic"
notes: Formerly Vertex AI express mode; a different product from the Gemini API in AI Studio (google-gemini), with its own endpoint and key. Available only to developers with a @gmail.com Google Account who are new to Google Cloud; existing Google Cloud users, or enabling billing, remove the 90-day free tier. Not part of the Google Cloud Free Program. Uses the global aiplatform.googleapis.com endpoint with the key in the x-goog-api-key header; the express-mode page does not say it is OpenAI-compatible. Commercial-use terms for the free tier not stated. Express-mode overview read 2026-11-24.
best_for: Trying Gemini 2.5/3.x through Google Cloud without billing

name: Inception (Mercury)
free_tier: One-time 100 million free tokens for every new account, shared across all Mercury models; no payment details required
rate_limits: Free Tier: 1,000 requests, 1,000,000 input tokens and 100,000 output tokens per minute
notes: Diffusion-based LLMs (Mercury 3, Mercury 2.5, Mercury 2, Mercury Edit 2), text only. The credit is shared across all models, not granted per model; add payment information to continue once it runs low. No official page states an expiry for the free tokens. By default the terms let Inception use API submissions to train its models; this can be switched off with the 'Improve the model for everyone' setting. Quick start, FAQ, rate-limit page and terms (effective 2025-09-01) read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Very fast diffusion LLMs for coding and agents, with a large one-time token grant

name: Aion Labs
free_tier: Free tier with a daily allowance usable on the API: 20,000 tokens a day; API keys activate after verifying a payment card that is never charged
rate_limits: Free tier: 15 requests/min, 20,000 tokens/min, 20,000 tokens/day
notes: EU provider (Deep Forge sp. z o.o., Warsaw). Free-tier API keys return 403 until a payment card is verified through Stripe on the Billing page; the card is never charged and one card can activate one free account. Models are Aion Labs' own multi-model systems built on DeepSeek and GLM, tuned for roleplay and storytelling, including mature themes; the service is for adults only. The docs do not say which models the free allowance covers. Pricing, rate-limit, quickstart and model pages, terms (version 2026-10-17) and privacy policy (effective 2026-11-16) read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Roleplay and long-form storytelling models through an OpenAI-compatible API

name: MegaNova AI
free_tier: Tier 1 (free registration, no card): a daily free quota of 50 requests per model on selected models (Manta Mini and Flash, Mistral Small 3.2, community roleplay fine-tunes, Qwen3 embeddings and BGE reranker), reset at 00:00 UTC
rate_limits: Tier 1: 60 requests/min, 200,000 tokens/min; 50 requests/day per free-quota model
notes: Roleplay-oriented inference platform (Nebula Nova Inc.) serving open and community fine-tuned models plus its own Manta models, alongside paid third-party models. Free quota is per account and per model; once it runs out, requests are billed only if paid usage after the free quota is switched on. Larger free quotas (and Manta Pro, GLM-4.7-Flash) need Tier 2, unlocked with a $1 deposit. An older FAQ page still lists DeepSeek-V3-0324 as free; the newer Tier 1, free-quota and pricing pages do not. The site terms and privacy policy say free modules are for evaluation and interactive use, not production, while the free-quota page mentions lightweight production use. The site terms also grant MegaNova a broad licence to content users submit. Tier 1, free-quota, pricing, terms and privacy pages read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Daily free allowances on roleplay-tuned open models through an OpenAI-compatible API

name: SEA-LION API (AI Singapore)
free_tier: Free proof-of-concept API key for AI Singapore's SEA-LION models (instruct, reasoning, guard and embeddings), rate-limited to 10 requests per minute
rate_limits: 10 requests/min per user (as of 2026-06-04); one API key per user
notes: Southeast Asian-language models from AI Singapore, a non-profit funded by Singapore's National Research Foundation. The key is created in the SEA-LION Playground after Google sign-in and is labelled 'Trial API Key'. The FAQ calls it a free API for proof-of-concept work, not designed for production; AI Singapore does not raise the limit and points production users to cloud partners (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI). No daily quota is published, and the FAQ mentions that keys can expire without saying when. The open model weights are free for commercial use when self-hosted; that is separate from this API. API guide, FAQ and terms of use read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Southeast Asian languages through an OpenAI-compatible API for prototypes

name: Azure Speech in Foundry Tools (Free F0)
free_tier: Free (F0) tier, every month: 5 audio hours of real-time speech to text, 0.5 million neural text-to-speech characters and 5 audio hours of speech translation
rate_limits: F0: 1 concurrent real-time speech-to-text request; text to speech 20 transactions per 60 seconds; batch transcription and batch synthesis not available on F0
notes: Requires an Azure account: Azure asks for a phone number and a non-prepaid credit or debit card to verify identity (a temporary one-dollar hold may appear; free account customers are not charged). Azure lists Speech among its free services with no 12-month limit. Free speech-to-text hours are shared between Standard and Custom models, and batch is not supported on F0. F0 quotas cannot be raised. Not OpenAI-compatible (Speech SDK and REST APIs). The free account offer excludes sovereign clouds (US Government, Azure China, Azure Germany). Pricing page, free-account FAQ, quotas page and the speech-to-text and text-to-speech data-handling pages read 2026-11-25.
best_for: A permanent monthly allowance of speech to text and neural text to speech from a major cloud

name: Lemonfox.ai
free_tier: First month free on the $5/month plan, which includes 10 million credits (about 30 hours of speech to text or 2 million characters of text to speech)
rate_limits: Not published; the terms allow a fair-use policy with rate limiting. Speech-to-text uploads up to 100 MB (1 GB by URL)
notes: German provider (Lemon Fox GmbH); payments through Paddle. One account covers OpenAI-compatible speech to text (Whisper large-v3, 100+ languages, diarization), text to speech (OpenAI- and ElevenLabs-compatible), an LLM chat API (open-weight DeepSeek V4 Flash by default, also MiMo V2.5 Pro) and image generation; the site offers the free month on its APIs without saying which ones it covers. No public page says whether the free month needs a payment method. After the month the plan costs $5/month plus $0.50 per extra million credits. Processing in the EU is available at eu-api.lemonfox.ai for a 20% surcharge. The terms allow a fair-use policy that may rate-limit or restrict new users. Homepage, API docs, terms and data policy page read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Low-cost Whisper transcription and TTS, plus an OpenAI-compatible chat API, with a free first month

name: Bytez
free_tier: Free plan at $0/month with $1 in free credits refreshed every 4 weeks, usable on open models up to 7B parameters and on closed models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Cohere) at provider price plus 2%
rate_limits: Free plan: 1 concurrent request on open models, 10 requests/second on closed models
notes: A model aggregator: open models run on Bytez serverless GPUs and are billed per second of inference (7B at $0.000072/second); closed models are passed through at the provider's price plus a 2% platform fee. Each $1 grant expires 4 weeks after it is issued, and larger open models (up to 120B) unlock only after buying credits. The OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint needs your own provider-key header for Cohere models. No public terms of service or privacy policy were found on bytez.com or docs.bytez.com, so commercial use and prompt handling are not recorded. Billing, OpenAI-compatible chat docs and pricing page read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Trying many small open models and the big closed APIs behind one key, with a small credit that renews every 4 weeks

name: Liquid AI
free_tier: One-time $2 in free API credit for every new organization on Liquid Console, usable on Liquid's own LFM text, vision and audio models and d1 decision models
rate_limits: Per organization and model; the limits are listed on the Models page of Liquid Console and are not published in the docs
notes: First-party API for Liquid's own small, fast models (LFM3, LFM2.5, d1). The console calls the $2 credit a limited-time offer; no official page states when it expires. The terms let Liquid use prompts and outputs to train and improve its models, and forbid using the service or outputs to develop, train or improve other AI models. The terms allow use for internal business purposes and to operate applications built on the API. Pricing page, FAQ, console, API docs, rate-limit docs and terms (updated 2026-09-30) read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Cheap, very small models for agents, classification and on-device-sized workloads, tried with a one-time credit

name: Public AI Inference Utility
free_tier: One-time $2 of free starter credit for every new user account, spent at the listed per-token prices on public and sovereign open models (Swiss AI Apertus, AI Singapore SEA-LION, Allen AI Olmo, Bielik)
rate_limits: Free tier: 100 requests/minute per API key
notes: Run by a nonprofit: a gateway that routes requests to inference partners (Swiss AI, AI Singapore, Allen AI and others) who host the open models. After the starter credit, add a payment method and top up the wallet. The terms call it a research service, not enterprise infrastructure, and say prompts may be sent to model providers that act as independent controllers and decide their own retention and training; technical logs are kept for no longer than 90 days. Every request needs a User-Agent header. Quick start, plans, models, partners FAQ and terms read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Trying public and sovereign open models (Apertus, SEA-LION, Olmo) through one OpenAI-compatible endpoint

name: Stability AI
free_tier: 25 free credits for a new Developer Platform account created with Google sign-in (1 credit = $0.01, so about $0.25): for example 8 Stable Image Core images at 3 credits each, or 3 Stable Image Ultra images at 8 credits
rate_limits: 150 requests every 10 seconds; past that the API answers 429 and blocks for 60 seconds
notes: The getting-started page ties the 25 credits to signing up with Google; it does not say whether a username-and-password account gets them. Credits are spent per call (e.g. SD 3.5 Large 6.5, Flash 2.5, Creative Upscaler 60) on image generation, editing, upscaling, 3D and Stable Audio; after that, credits cost $1 per 100. The terms say unused service credits, including promotional ones, expire one year after issuance unless otherwise specified. Commercial use of API outputs is allowed and you own the outputs; the terms forbid using outputs to train a model that competes with Stability. The Community License page (free below $1M annual revenue) is about self-hosting the models; it does not say the threshold applies to API outputs.
best_for: Trying Stable Image and Stable Diffusion 3.5 over an API with a small no-cost credit

name: PLaMo API (Preferred Networks)
free_tier: Free plan at 0 yen per token for PLaMo 3.0 / 3.1 Prime and PLaMo 3.0 Fin Beta, available right after sign-up, with usage and rate limits; includes limited web search
rate_limits: 100 requests/min per API key for the plamo-3.0-prime family; plamo-3.0-fin-beta 50 requests per user per 24 hours (shared with PLaMo Chat); the limits page has no plan column, and the plan page calls the Free plan rate limit "standard"
notes: Japanese-language LLMs from Preferred Networks, Inc. The terms (in Japanese) require users to be 18 or older and residents of Japan or Japanese corporations. On the Free plan, prompts and outputs are stored and used for training, ZDR does not apply, and personal information must not be entered; paid plans do not train on prompts. The docs call the API mostly compatible with the openai library. plamo-3.0-prime is discontinued on 2027-01-31 and switches to plamo-3.1-prime. The terms page renders only with JavaScript, so commercial use is not recorded as a flag here; the terms forbid using outputs to develop or train other models. Plan page (rendered), English docs (pricing, limits, getting started, API reference) and terms read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Japanese-language chat and reasoning on a no-cost plan, for users in Japan

name: Entrim
free_tier: One-time $10 in free credits for new users, claimed after a temporary $1 card authorization hold; usable on the serverless open-model API
rate_limits: Rate limits may apply to requests, tokens or both (HTTP 429 when exceeded); no figures are published
notes: EU provider (E3M d.o.o., Slovenia) running open models on its own GPUs in Slovenia. The card-setup credit must be claimed within 7 days of email verification and expires 14 days after it is granted unless you make a paid top-up; it is not available in every country or to every account, and only one account per person or organization is allowed. The terms say prompts and outputs are processed in memory and not stored, except a KV cache kept up to 7 days, and are not used for training. The terms let customers use output for lawful purposes but do not name commercial use. Landing page, pricing, data-privacy page, terms and privacy policy read 2026-11-25.
best_for: EU-hosted open models (GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemma, gpt-oss) with no training on prompts, tried with a $10 credit

name: Infomaniak AI Services
free_tier: One million free credits to test AI Services for one month (each request consumes one credit or LLM token); a payment card must be registered
rate_limits: No rate-limit figures are published; context windows up to 256,000 input tokens depending on the model
notes: Swiss provider (Infomaniak Network SA) running open models in its own data centres in Switzerland through OpenAI-compatible APIs. A valid payment card is registered at sign-up as an anti-fraud check; usage beyond the credit is billed at the end of the month, and a spending limit can be set. The API path includes your product id, so there is no fixed base URL. The site says queries are neither recorded nor used for training. The page does not say which models the credit covers. AI Services page, prices, models page, getting-started FAQ and terms index read 2026-11-25.
best_for: Swiss-hosted open models (Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, Apertus, Kimi) with no query storage, tried for a month
